about: The check-in, wallet and gate screens' wording. render_airline.py checks every string under traveler as it checks the pages: no rule, theorem or criterion, no requirement ID, no typed amount. Strings under lean show only with the Lean model. Under lean, requirements must name requirements the model has, open must name criteria that are still open, and element must name an identifier of the model. Results are computed; this file holds only the words for each result.

traveler.note: Verified Airline is a fictional airline. The traveler, the flight and the credentials are specimens.

legend.open: A criterion is an open question
legend.text: Each check runs as TypeScript in this browser. The tests compare it with the model's answer on every row of the model's table. That is a test of those cases; the proofs are about the Lean model. No signature or protocol is checked, because the model holds no cryptography.
